import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Fix sex label variant and keep only allowed values
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df.loc[~df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']), 'sex'] = pd.NA
    # Fix body_mass_g: text with commas, then numeric, then enforce range
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # Fix flipper_length_mm: coerce to numeric and enforce valid range
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Group by sex and compute mean body mass, dropping missing group keys
    means = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    result = {}
    for k, v in means.items():
        if pd.notna(k) and pd.notna(v):
            result[str(k)] = float(v)
    return result
